name: MonarchInlineEditText
title: InlineEditText
wrapsNative: Button that swaps to TextField (or TextEditor for several lines) with @FocusState; MonarchButton for Save and Cancel
summary: Text that turns into a field in place, with an asynchronous save, a pending state and an error that keeps the editor open.
whenToUse: For one value that is edited where it is shown: a title, a name, a short description.
whenNotToUse: For several fields edited together, use a form with MonarchTextField and Save in the toolbar. For text that is always editable, use MonarchTextField.
api: init(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, prompt: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isMultiline: Bool = false, startsEditing: Bool = false, trimsWhitespace: Bool = true, savesOnFocusLoss: Bool = true, editHint: String? = nil, saveTitle: String? = nil, cancelTitle: String? = nil, savingLabel: String? = nil, failureMessage: String? = nil, validate: (@MainActor (String) -> String?)? = nil, onCancel: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSave: @escaping @MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)

options.name: label
options.description: What the text is, for example "Title". Read by VoiceOver; not drawn.

options.name: text
options.description: The saved value. Written after a successful save.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in view mode while the value is empty, and as the placeholder of the field.

options.name: error
options.description: An error from the app, for example an edit conflict, shown while editing.

options.name: isMultiline
options.description: Uses a TextEditor: Return adds a line and Save saves.

options.name: startsEditing
options.description: Opens the editor when the view first appears.

options.name: trimsWhitespace
options.description: Trims the draft before comparing and saving.

options.name: savesOnFocusLoss
options.description: Saves the draft when focus leaves the field.

options.name: savingLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Saving" spoken value of the Save button.

options.name: failureMessage
options.description: Replaces the built-in message of a failed save whose error has no description.

options.name: validate
options.description: Returns a message to refuse a draft before saving.

options.name: onSave
options.description: Persists a new value. Not called when the value is unchanged. Throwing keeps the editor open.

states.name: viewing
states.description: The value in the default text colour with a small pencil; an empty value shows the prompt in the subtle colour.

states.name: editing
states.description: A bordered field with the focus ring, and Save and Cancel buttons under it.

states.name: saving
states.description: The field is disabled, Save shows progress and Cancel is disabled.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger border, and an icon and message under the field. The draft is kept.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With disabled(_:) the value is plain text in the disabled colour and cannot be edited.

appearance: View mode is body text with a muted pencil. The editor is a surface-coloured field with an input border and 8-point corners, the theme's focus ring, a small primary Save button and a ghost Cancel button. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: On the web, Enter saves and Escape cancels, and Save and Cancel buttons are optional for a single line. A touch keyboard has no Escape key, so on iOS the two buttons are always shown; Return still saves a single line and a hardware Escape still cancels. The web shows a spinner inside the field; here the Save button shows the progress. The value is a binding that the component writes after onSave succeeds, in place of the web's controlled value. The web's controlled editing state is reduced to startsEditing, and onSaveError is the error thrown by onSave, which the app can catch inside its own closure. The multi-line editor has a fixed height that scales with Dynamic Type and scrolls, because TextEditor does not size itself to its text. Several closures are optional (validate, onCancel). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is validate.
accessibility: In view mode it is one button: label, then the value (or the prompt) as the value, then "Edit" as the hint.
In edit mode the field has the same label, and an error is its hint, spoken as "Error: …".
A new error is announced when it appears, and is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
While saving, the Save button's value is "Saving".
The text in view mode and the field are at least 44 points high; text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A draft equal to the saved value closes the editor without calling onSave.
A draft that has just been refused or has failed is not saved again when focus leaves the field.
A second save and Cancel are ignored while a save runs.
An error of a type that conforms to LocalizedError shows its errorDescription; any other error shows failureMessage or the built-in sentence.
With no value and no prompt the view mode shows only the pencil.
If the view goes away while a save runs, the save still finishes and writes the binding.
